name: Special Meeting of the City Council - Closed Session
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council – CLOSED SESSION
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 26, 2024 – 5:30 p.m.
  .

 Members of the public may join this meeting in-person in the Council Chambers. Written
 comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than 12:00 p.m.
 on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the meeting and
 posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
  or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

  Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
  central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications.
  Sign up using “Notify Me” https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx

  If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours
  prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours
  and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
  Packets
 CALL TO ORDER: 5:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments on Closed Session Items only. Members of the public may offer comment in-
person or via email as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. Live comments will be limited to three
minutes. Public Comments may be presented via a written comment, see Page 1 for deadline.
Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called to speak while in the Council
Chambers.

CLOSED SESSION:

1.  Conference with Labor Negotiators
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager
  City Designated Representatives: Mayor Ned Davis and Mayor Pro Tem Kelly
  Honig

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, June 21, 2024 at 1:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  June 21, 2024
